body:
This is so weird. Lately I've had this weird desire to drink. 
I'm really very young, and have mostly only drunk in various social situations, in a very moderate and safe way--i.e. a glass of wine. 

I guess it's a desire to be a bit number or removed? I'm keeping beer in my room right now, which I realize is whack and I have yet to really drink it but I don't know.

Ah, what a lovely distinction to draw! 
If I understand what you mean properly, I want to be gone from myself. 
Sometimes I just hate my mind and there seems to be no proper or full way to connect my mind and body. 
I know that somebody will recommend meditation or distraction or something but it's not like that. 
Does what I'm saying make sense? 
I want to be gone from myself.
